agenda_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Scott Snider, Vice-Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Mary Smith, Committee Member
Edward Padgett, Committee Member  Bette Donovan, Committee Member

  Wednesday, May 20, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  None

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, April 15, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Update
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 5/20/2026  Page 2

  c. Bingo Report
  d. Account Balance Update
  e. Monthly Program Fees
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update
  g. AgingNext
  h. Facilities Report
  i. Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Thursday, May 14, 2026, on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.laverneca.gov
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, May 20, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 20, 2026.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, Edward Padgett, Mary Smith, George
  Borst.

  Members Absent: Bette Donovan, Jenny Jolly

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by George Borst and seconded by Ed Padgett to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, April 15, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 548 meals were served to an average of 24 participants in
  April. Meals have been lowered to 27 meals per day due to budget constraints
  with the YWCA.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Receipts for April totaled $10,145.00 (rent to City of La Verne
  $272.00; supplies expense to Bingo West $1,435.00; Tablecloths $48.00;
  Snack Table $21.00; Payouts $6,760.00). Attendance over 5 dates was 380
  participants.

5. Account Balance: Armando shared that the balance has gone down from $5,559.11
  because of Senior Dance, Senior Volunteer Recognition Luncheon, and renewal
  of the Motion Picture License.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: The spring session is going well. Spring session will end on
  June, 12, 2026. Summer session will begin on Monday, June 22, 2026.

8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of April
  was 3.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: No update.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, May 21st– Public Works Open House, City Yard, 4:00PM – 6:00PM.
  •  Friday, May 22nd – Mt. SAC Registration, 10:00AM – 12:00PM.
  •  Monday, May 25th – Memorial Day Ceremony, Veterans Hall, 11:00AM.
  •  Wednesday, May 27th – Senior Seminar, Navigating Health Care Decisions as We Age, APF Hospice,
  10:30AM.
  •  Friday, May 29th – Excursion, South Coast Botanical Garden & Riviera Village, 8:00AM – 4:30PM.
  •  Friday, May 29th – Senior Seminar, Reduce Your Stroke Risk and Stay Independent, Motiv8 Rehab,
  10:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, June 3rd – Senior Seminar, Summer Tips for Seniors, What Medicare Covers at Home
  and Abroad, Embrace Health Insurance.
  •  Monday, June 9th – Movie Matinee, Young Frankenstein, 12:30PM.
  •  Thursday, June 11th – Excursion, Agua Caliente Casino Rancho Mirage, 9:00AM – 5:00PM.
  •  Friday, June 12th – Senior Seminar, Health, Wellness, and Wholeness, Los Angeles County
  Department of Mental Health, 10:30AM.

  Public Comments: Armando shared that he and Robyn have begun working on
  bylaws for the Senior Advisory Committee. Terry shared the proclamation which
  was presented to the Committee by the La Verne City Council at recent Council
  Meeting in honor of Older Americans Month. There was a suggestion that a copy
  be made and placed on a wall in the Community Center.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:26AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
